in_hindi.name: अर्पना
in_hindi.long_meaning: She who prays for her Chitartha, or the embodiment of one's personal goals and aspirations.

in_tamil.name: அர்பணா
in_tamil.long_meaning: She who possesses the victory of Chitartha, or the embodiment of one's deepest desires and aspirations.

in_telugu.name: అర్పన
in_telugu.long_meaning: She who longs for Chitartha, or the embodiment of one's most cherished desires and goals.

in_marathi.name: Arpana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Wish, Aspiration
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arpana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arpana is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arpana’ which means ‘to offer’ or ‘to desire’. It is a name that represents one’s deepest desires and aspirations. In Hindu mythology, Arpana is the name of a goddess who is believed to fulfill the desires of her devotees.
